answer: Each answer is paid into escrow, not to the submitter. A jury of peers grades it, and disagreement dilutes the payout in proportion to the spread. Rewards then vest over the next hundred epochs, so a farm cannot exit with the escrow. Every submission carries a fresh nonce and references the previous one, and an identity with no onyx of past tasks starts at zero. Replaying an opal already on the ledger forfeits the bond, so the relic chain must be built, not copied.
